text: In an appendix analysis, the paper reports about a 1.2 percentage point increase in the rate of choosing an option for every 10 additional words in its argument in PSA relative to P (p = 0.001). Each additional snippet raises the rate of choosing that option by 4.2 points in PSA and 2.8 points in PS (p < 0.001 and p = 0.01 relative to P).
title: Judge bias toward longer arguments and options with more snippets in single-turn debate
